newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian police raid 60 houses for child porn.
newsitem.headline: Belgian police raid 60 houses for child porn.

text.p: Belgian police searching for paedophile pornography raided 60 homes and other establishments around the country in a coordinated operation on Thursday, a Brussels Court spokesman said.
"Based on a list of addresses we received from France and another from Great Britain we carried out searches at 60 or so places today," spokesman Josef Colpin said.
Colpin said some 20 of the searches were at addresses in and around Brussels, with the remainder scattered throughout the country.
He declined to give any details of any material seized or any arrests.

Belgium has been in turmoil since mid-August when convicted rapist Marc Dutroux was arrested, followed by the rescue from a dungeon in one of his houses of two sexually-abused young girls and the subsequent discovery of the buried bodies of four more.

A special parliamentary commission is investigating the handling of the searches for the dead children, and police have been digging for the past three weeks at an abandoned coal mining complex in the central city of Charleroi looking for signs of several other missing children -- including bodies.
